title: Beetle High Priest
description: A surreal hybrid creature with a beetle body, goat-like horns, and a long bird beak stands atop a mound. It holds a rainbow-filled bowl from which multicolored liquid pours, while a circle of smaller beetle-like followers gathers around a central flame below.
prompt: Surreal black and white ink drawing of a large beetle-bodied creature with long curved goat horns and a bird-like beak, standing on a mound. It holds a bowl overflowing with bright rainbow liquid that drips down. Below it, a circle of smaller white beetle followers surrounds a central flame. Occult symbols and golden circles float in the background, psychedelic ritual atmosphere.
medium: pen and ink with digital color
